original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹人民国防军称上尼罗河冲突中13名苏丹人民解放军反对派武装人员被打死
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹人民国防军（SSPDF）称，10月3日至4日在上尼罗河州Wunkur的两天战斗中，13名苏丹人民解放军反对派（SPLA-IO）武装人员被打死，另有1人受伤被俘。SSPDF发言人称政府军击退了对方多次进攻并仍控制该地区。SPLA-IO则给出相互矛盾的说法，称其部队攻占了Wunkur并使政府军及盟军遭受伤亡。双方说法均无法得到独立核实。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹人民国防军称13名苏丹人民解放军反对派武装人员在两天的战斗中被打死
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 13 fighters from the Sudan People’s Liberation Army-In Opposition (SPLA-IO) were killed and another wounded and captured during two days of fighting in Wunkur, Upper Nile State

key_facts.fact: SSPDF发言人称政府军击退了10月3日和4日对Wunkur阵地的多次进攻并仍控制该地区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: government forces repelled repeated attacks on their position in Wunkur on Oct. 3 and 4. He said government forces remained in control of the area after the clashes

key_facts.fact: SSPDF称在现场缴获包括PKM机枪、RPG-7火箭筒和两支AK-47步枪在内的四件武器
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: recovered four weapons from the scene, including a PKM machine gun, an RPG-7 rocket-propelled grenade launcher and two AK-47 rifles

key_facts.fact: SPLA-IO给出相互矛盾的说法，称其部队攻占Wunkur并使政府军及盟军遭受伤亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The SPLA-IO has given a conflicting account of the fighting, saying its forces captured Wunkur and inflicted casualties on government and allied forces

uncertainties: SSPDF公布的伤亡数字与SPLA-IO的说法相互矛盾，均无法得到独立核实
目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
